notes.title: Card balance changes and bug fixes for you
notes.content:
Did ya'll had some great Holidays and enjoyed playing KARDS during the season?

Today, 12th of January, we are updating KARDS with card balance changes and bug fixes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/95c34a8d3ff7f45c1428a1514fec0aef269de206.jpg[/img]

Additionally, to celebrate the first KARDS update of the year, we have new special offers in the KARDS shop - make sure to check them out!

We thank all of our engaged players and the KARDS community in general for reporting bugs and discussing the game balance.

[url=http://discord.gg/kards]If you want to get involved as well, please join us on Discord![/url]

Before we go into the details, we invite you to watch our latest patch preview with developer Olikrummi and expert Innocent Bubbles.

[previewyoutube=WFqBDDMbL_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, onto the patch notes details!

[h2]Card Balance Changes[/h2]

📜 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/544810/view/2935750925540804774]Read our latest dev blog on the card balance changes to discover the details and to explore the background info![/url]

[b][u]FLAMMPANZER[/u][/b]

Deployment: Destroy target enemy ground unit with cost 1 or less.
(Was: Deployment: Destroy target enemy unit with cost 1 or less.)

[b][u]17th RIFLE REGIMENT[/u][/b]

Operation cost increased by 1 to now 2 Kredits.

[b][u]RUSH PRODUCTION[/u][/b]

Cost increased by 1 to now 1 Kredit.

[b][u]NIGHT WITCHES[/u][/b]

Add a POLIKARPOV PO-2 OR FROM THE PEOPLE to hand. Shuffle NIGHT WITCHES into your deck.
(Was: Add a POLIKARPOV PO-2 and FROM THE PEOPLE to hand. Shuffle NIGHT WITCHES into your deck.)

[b][u]ENCIRCLEMENT[/u][/b]

Cost increased by 1 to now 3 Kredits.

[b][u]BOLSTER THE RANKS[/u][/b]

Cost increased by 1 to now 4 Kredits.

[b][u]SEABORNE INVASION[/u][/b]

Cost increased by 1 to now 9 Kredits.

[b][u]COUNTER OFFENSIVE[/u][/b]

Target infantry or tank gets +2+2 for each damaged unit on the battlefield.
(Was: Target infantry or tank gets +1+1 for each damaged unit on the battlefield.)

[b][u]BARRAGE[/u][/b]

Choose one - enemy units have -3 attack this turn OR deal 5 damage to a ground unit.
(Was: Choose one - enemy units have -2 attack this turn OR deal 4 damage to a ground unit.)

[b][u]EXPLOIT THE GAP[/u][/b]

Cost reduced by 1 to now 6 Kredits.

[b][u]HEINKEL HE 219[/u][/b]

When your HQ is damaged by a ground unit, deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ.
(Was: When your HQ is damaged by a non-HEINKEL HE 219 source, deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ.)

[b][u]P-51 MUSTANG[/u][/b]

Deployment: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy air unit.
(Was: Deployment: Give enemy air units +1 operation cost.)

[b][u]DIVE BOMBING[/u][/b]

Give an enemy unit -3 attack and -1 defense until the start of your next turn.
(Was: Give an enemy unit -2 attack and -1 defense until the start of your next turn.)

[b][u]SURPRISE ATTACK[/u][/b]

Cost decreased by 1 to now 1 Kredit.

[b][u]CALL TO THE COLONIES[/u][/b]

Cost reduced by 1 to now 4 Kredits.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]EMPIRE OF THE SUN draws fewer cards than the target enemy unit attack value if the attack value was buffed from a M8 Greyhound. Fixed.
[*]Enemy air unit receives another debuff from the 37mm ANTI-AIRCRAFT GUN when returning after being controlled by CONFUSION. Fixed.
[*]AICHI D3A-2 doesn't lose buff from another AICHI D3A-2 after using  the CONFUSION order on one of them and destroying it. Fixed
[*]Pz. BEFEHLSWAGEN 35t makes you draw M4A1 from your deck when its effect triggers. Fixed.
[*]120mm M1 GUN wasn't resetting correctly after leaving the board and played again. Fixed.
[*]C-47 SKYTRAIN was giving back the kredits spent by Ki-61 TONY from its trigger effect. Fixed.
[*]FW 200 CONDOR's deployment effect wasn't correctly canceled by EVASIVE ACTION. Fixed.
[*]Destruction effect removals are not resetting when after-affected cards left the board and played again. Fixed.
[*]Cards that kept immunity after losing OUTMANUEVER's effect would still lose the visual icon. Fixed.
[*]Card backs are overlapped by cards in the "Collection" tab after double-clicking on "Card back". Fixed.
[*]The KARDS Store banner doesn't change after clicking on the "Change banner" button. Fixed.
[*]The Chinese font has been updated to fix issues with its readability.
[*]Several incorrect translations have been fixed.
[*]Keywords in the Chinese translation are now in bold font (similar to other languages).
[/list]

Give us a thumbs up if you like this update. 

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/kards]We also welcome more feedback in the comments below and on KARDS Discord![/url]

Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: Out with the Old, In with the New
notes.content:
2020 is behind us now, and what a fabulous year it was… for KARDS!

We’re starting the new year off with a bang of a balance patch, ready to wreck ruin on all your decks to usher the new year in with style. 

This patch will hit the nearest battlefield tomorrow, January 12th, so brace yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/6220833c9f1fad0092005e7f8880a8b1da57fd23.jpg[/img]

The last few balance patches were not accompanied by a dev blog, which made some people sad. 

Sad is bad, as the saying goes and as we’re banned from hugging you to make you feel better, we’re forced to do the next best thing, which is publishing a new dev blog. 

So here we are.

In light of the new times, we’re shaking things up slightly - instead of going by nations, the card changes are being grouped into three categories - nerfed cards, underused card buffs and strategic buffs. Read on to find out what these enigmatic terms mean.

Per usual, the patch tomorrow will also see numerous bug fixes, stay tuned for the full patch notes for further details.

[h2]Nerfed Cards[/h2]

The first category consists of cards we want to tune down in power for one reason or another. 

This can be because the card is too strong, sees too much play, is too oppressive in certain scenarios, or we want to tone down a specific strategy the card empowers. 

For this category, success is based on the tears shed.

[h3]FLAMMPANZER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/bd4135c4790ae5c0bbe33127a439d21b02399821.png[/img]

The Flammpanzer is a very important tool in keeping aggressive decks in check, and we want to keep it like that. 

But it does a bit too much and the once-popular British small air deck has suffered because of the Fire in the Sky panzer.

[h3]17th RIFLE REGIMENT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/ec3c8941167937b9dda1729d37f3bf99e60ea97c.png[/img]
This card is very powerful in the lower brackets of the game and in draft. Slowing it down takes the sting out of it a little bit while maintaining its powerful abilities. This should still be a popular choice for newer players, just not as oppressive.

[h3]RUSH PRODUCTION[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/ab5312751df6d01c19c0ee4dd826487c97d5be58.png[/img]
Rush Production is best known for its role as the Kredit generating villain in the infamous Baby Combo deck. But in recent months it has been getting credits in other productions as well, playing its stereotypical role of a ‘puke-your-hand-out’ enabler. 

Good villain roles are always appreciated, but this one needs to go back to its sideshow roots.

[h3]NIGHT WITCHES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/1e312e071349654246a03c96a9a8efd5e73e364d.png[/img]
This change retains the ‘endless’ value of the card, but reduces its power significantly. 

While the Soviet value decks are not over-performing, they can lead to fairly long and tedious battles, which reliable sources tell us is boring if encountered too frequently.

[h3]ENCIRCLEMENT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/fca3d0e743b069c3817785ac6a7939f11589ba2e.png[/img]
When we added the Blitz clause to this card a few months back, it saw Encirclement blitz into top tier status overnight.

At the time, aggressive decks needed a bit of love, but now they have too much love, so we are scaling this card back or we will end up with a spoiled brat.

[h3]BOLSTER THE RANKS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/e209dfc70f468612b7cdf99389b82f8ef686fa57.png[/img]
Bolster the Ranks saw the advent of a new archetype of sorts, where operation cost matters much more. 

This archetype has been very successful, so successful in fact that we are required to bolster the cost of the card to 4.

This will not kill the archetype, as we like it in general, but does slow it down a bit.

[h3]SEABORNE INVASION[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/df08fc5a1cb6877d75dd25230d54a322a5228a99.png[/img]
Since this card came out we’ve seen an invasion of new cards that increase its potential power.

With this borne in mind we sea no other option but to increase the cost to 9.

[h2]Buff little used cards[/h2]

This category has cards that see play so rarely that when they do pop up you wonder if your opponent is a genius or a madman (often both). 

For this category, success is based on damns given.

[h3]COUNTER OFFENSIVE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/ee39d2e220da3b66f646071c11427bef46194789.png[/img]
The damaged unit theme the Soviets have is pretty weak right now, but has big potential in the future, especially as, believe it or not, units do tend to get damaged in the normal course of a battle.

Strengthening this card is not going to propel this understrength strategy into the forefront, but is a step in that direction.

[h3]BARRAGE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/ec5fc96b24e30f2a0d1368ae91ea3bcc59ed6121.png[/img]
Barrage is not intended to be a strong card, but rather a role-player for newer players and in draft. Nevertheless, the two choices it gives are currently so weak that the choice tends to be not to play the card at all. 

So we are making the card slightly more appealing for its intended audience.

[h3]EXPLOIT THE GAP[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/d7d589b7e67a9258fca3f62759dc795d947a7911.png[/img]
Exploit the Gap has a huge potential ceiling, but requires a lot of hoops to jump through. 

Too many hoops it turns out as the card sees very little play. Let’s hope a lower cost sees the card hop, skip and jump to a higher play rate.

[h2]Cards buffed for strategic reasons[/h2]

This final category sees cards that we want to strengthen for various strategic reasons. 

This can be to promote a deck archetype we feel is underplayed, to strengthen a tool against a popular strategy or, most importantly, just to mess with our players (don’t tell them). 

For this category, success is based on the amount of ant farms upset.

[h3]HEINKEL HE 219[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/be6d9ec15c71d5c1cf27024998ab637bdcd2122e.png[/img]
In the Allegiance set we introduced the you-hurt-me-I-hurt-you theme for the Germans on a couple of cards. 

While Retaliation has seen a fair amount of play, the Heinkel has never really taken off.  Part of the problem is that the old version reads like a Poe horror story. 

The new version reads much cleaner and even if it is a slightly less powerful ability, it more than makes up for it with a lower cost.

Will it still be stuck on the ground? Nevermore!

[h3]P-51 MUSTANG[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/1731c775396f5075f15c802d6b6ef4821f50d31b.png[/img]
This iconic plane sees no play, for a good reason. We want to put it in the spotlight where it should be. 

More importantly, we are anticipating more air decks showing up, or at least more decks with a few powerful air units, and want to create more tools to deal with them.

[h3]DIVE BOMBING[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/32bec36c207d4315917c5c08baaa24de7369ffee.png[/img]
Dive Bombing is a versatile, but not overly powerful, tool. It acts as a removal against many small, aggressive units, but can also soften up a unit before attacking into it, or simply buy you time by reducing incoming damage next turn. 

We don’t want to strengthen Dive Bombing as a removal tool, but we do want to strengthen its other applications, hence the change.

[h3]SURPRISE ATTACK[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/c748460e224fa0fdd86d9fa667597a1a6e6876fe.png[/img]
A pin-based strategy is rarely seen except in a handful of decks aiming to drag the game out. 

While we are wary of strengthening non-interactive strategies too much, we feel this change to Surprise Attack gives a solid boost to pin-strategies without causing too many issues.

[h3]CALL TO THE COLONIES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/46ef222096a48e8c3b93e0fe5e9caa62310c5ff4.png[/img]
France is finally crawling out of the shadow of Resistance decks and exploring other deck strategies. 

We want to encourage these attempts and this change to Call to the Colonies makes an already decent card quite potent in several archetypes.


That’s it for now. It will be interesting to see how these changes affect the metagame once the patch is live tomorrow, January 12th. 

Look out for the full patch notes with information on various bug fixes as well. We have many more changes and additions coming in the upcoming weeks and months, so stay tuned. 

We’ll see you on the battlefield, commander!

notes.title: KARDS World Champion 2020 - Winner announcement
notes.content:
Congratulations to the winner of the KARDS World Championship 2020:

[h1]CCMS-031 - KARDS World Champion 2020[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/8322effd3b925a64032f91ce1b35f3d50ebfdb41.jpg[/img]

In a dramatic and nerve-wracking World Championship finals on December 6, CCMS-031 won the best-of-five series against Fenrir with 3-1.

[h2]World Championship[/h2]

Over the past six months, more than 1,000 players from around the globe have battled to reach the finals for a chance to compete for the title of the KARDS World Champion and for part of the $10,000 prize pool.

The four best players were ready to battle it out in a virtual final orchestrated from at the KARDS Headquarters in Reykjavik, Iceland.

[h2]The Four Champions[/h2]

Before we go into the details, let's have a look at our four champions qualified for the semi-finals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/e308a2742bd59b4d9730e78e12e461e49dc1a558.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/d1d3c93b4def02ea73a4788b459c5309755e8d92.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/58427d35d52d1a5dca7110af25045763ced6d81e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/caa881ce2258cb15b962f9cf09659147766f265f.jpg[/img]

[h2]First: Honorable Mentions[/h2]

This final weekend of the World Championship kicked off with the semi-finals and the battle for 3rd place.

CCMS-031 and Fenrir won the semi-final matches relatively clearly against Darkness and CU元素收集大师 with 2-0 and 3-1.

Reaching the semi-finals of the KARDS World Championship against almost 1000 contestants is a major achievement. Congratulations to Darkness and CU元素收集大师!

[h2]The Final Battle: World Champion[/h2]

The final battle between CCMS-031 and Fenrir couldn't have been more dramatic. The pressure on both players was immense.

CCMS-031 showed brilliant gameplay and superior tactics throughout the finals leading to a convincing victory from start to finish. However, Fenrir was able to withstand the pressure and created several opportunities to turn the tide but couldn’t score the winning moves.

The following matches were testimonies for the great skills of both players. With excellent tactical maneuvers, great strategic planning and cunning mind-games, it was an exciting display of what the best KARDS players are capable of and a joy to watch! KARDS is indeed quite easy to learn, but you can also go extremely deep. The battle waged forth and back until the score was 2-1.

This final match was a mini-drama in itself, it was unclear till the end who was going to win. After 14 minutes in that final match and 26 turns, CCMS-031 won the final match and the title of KARDS World Champion 2020.

Fair sportsmanship all around as Fenrir immediately shook virtual hands and congratulated CCMS-031 for winning the finals and for becoming the second KARDS World Champion.

[h2]The Results[/h2]

1st place and KARDS World Champion 2020: CCMS-031

2nd place: Fenrir

3rd place: Darkness

4th place: CU元素收集大师

notes.content:
With the upcoming KARDS winter expansion Breakthrough, fundamentally new tactical and strategic options inspired by real WW2 history become available to your arsenal.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2914353754874480432][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/9178979aab884e4d0a6cc32f844d5d6007e510a3.jpg[/img][/url]

Stay up to date, theorycraft along for a Breakthrough, and subscribe to KARDS Facebook, KARDS YouTube, and Twitter. We invite you to also keep an eye on the #cards_reveal channel on Discord.

Without further ado, here is the batch of all reveals from the previous week!

[h2]Take advantage: Control the Enemy[/h2]

On the battlefield, chaos can reign, and friendly fire can become as deadly as enemy attacks.

Switching sides during WWII was also not uncommon, even for nations. At the start of WWII Romania, Bulgaria and Italy were allied with the Axis powers, but the war’s developments in later years would influence these countries decisions to switch their allegiance to the Allies. 

An example a take control is CONFUSION, where you can take control of an enemy unit, with cost of 3 or less, until end of turn. This effect is the abstraction of a unit becoming confused during battle and therefore not acting as they should.

Another example is MINORITY RECRUITS, where you can take full control of an enemy unit. This effect is the abstraction of turning to the enemy.

[h2]Card reveals: The Second Strike[/h2]

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34861374/a48210a191ef4e1625daeb2a0359275bf2ef9141.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/257b57724301b444d2e9e148744b2f177437b9dd.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Spoiler season: First card reveals for Winter expansion "Breakthrough"
notes.content:
With the upcoming KARDS winter expansion Breakthrough, fundamentally new tactical and strategic options inspired by real WW2 history become available to your arsenal.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2914353754874480432][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/9178979aab884e4d0a6cc32f844d5d6007e510a3.jpg[/img][/url]

We spice up the road to Breakthrough, arriving on December 9th, by revealing thrilling new cards and introducing exciting news about the upcoming game mechanics. Almost every day now, something new is disclosed either by the community or directly by the KARDS dev team.

Stay up to date, theorycraft along for a Breakthrough, and subscribe to [url=https://www.facebook.com/KARDSccg/]KARDS Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVp6iL4xiS8ra1JvNfEd7aA]KARDS YouTube[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/KARDSccg]Twitter[/url]. We invite you to also keep an eye on the [url=https://discord.gg/7khxvrA]#cards_reveal[/url] channel on Discord.

Enough of the words -  here are the latest reveals!

[h2]Pincer ability: Double or none![/h2]

First, we look at the tantalizing new Pincer gameplay (revealed during the [url=https://youtu.be/MiWSjLOV41c]Officer Club Championship broadcast[/url]).

In military terms, a pincer movement is a coordinated and simultaneous attack of separate forces to encircle the enemy and then simultaneously attack them on both flanks or from opposing directions. The maneuver relies on both groups encircling the enemy to succeed in deploying their devastating blow. The pincer movement was an integral part of the German Blitzkrieg and was often used to shocking effect during World War II.

The KARDS Pincer ability is inspired by this real-world tactic and recreates this attack in an abstract yet realistic way on the battlefield.

When a Pincer unit enters the battlefield, you can choose another friendly unit as a counterpart of the Pincer. This effect is the abstraction of two units working together to pincer the opponent. Only while both units are on the battlefield will they both get the Pincer benefit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/73b3a2d3df1341458b3f356649340cbc8726a4c3.png[/img]

For example: A Pincer: +2 Attack would give the Pincer unit +2 attack and the other selected unit +2 attack - as long as they both are on the battlefield. If either unit is removed from the battlefield, the other remaining unit automatically loses the +2 Pincer attack bonus.

There are many different Pincer improvements available, not just attack boni.

[h2]The first card reveals[/h2]

Are you ready for the massive amount of card reveals since the expansion announcement the previous week? This is just a fraction of what's to come!

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34861374/567af55237f7c96a192f1578fec60c8210760fb2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/567af55237f7c96a192f1578fec60c8210760fb2.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Open Draft Tournament this weekend!
notes.content:
Hello KARDS community!

It's time for a community competition of epic proportions! To warm-up for the Breakthrough expansion release, we will feature a community-wide draft competition this upcoming weekend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/23ccc557d00a8133e1fcb22460674acd7a65fea9.jpg[/img]

But that is not all: [b]We will shuffle some of the Breakthrough cards into the set of Draft cards - this is your chance to experience Breakthrough for the first time![/b]

To top the weekend even further, you can enjoy a special Draft bundle offer never seen before in the KARDS store!

[h2]How will it work?[/h2]
For the weekend of the 20th - 22nd of November (starting at 00'00'01 UTC on the 20th and ending at 02'00'00 UTC on the 23rd), we will keep track of all draft games played across all KARDS players. Specifically, we are looking at the number of wins you are racking up. Each day, we will announce the top-30 leaderboard of players (count of draft wins) currently positioned to claim the prizes that lay ahead.

On Monday the 23rd of November, we will announce the 30 players with the most amount of wins during the competition period that will walk away with additional prizes and the honor of knowing they are among the world's best draft players!

We will also draw 10 extra players from the total pool of players who played any draft matches during the weekend to receive additional prizes.

[h2]How do I participate?[/h2]
It's as simple: Just play at least one round of draft matches, and you are in with a chance! No further signup or registration is required!

[h2]The Prizes[/h2]
The prizes for this competition aren't something to scoff at!

[list][*]The top 5 players will receive the complete Breakthrough expansion Pre-order
[*]The next 5 players will receive 3x Breakthrough Officer Packs and 5 Standard Packs
[*]The next 10 players will receive 2x Breakthrough Officer Packs and 3 Standard Packs
[*]The next 10 players will receive 1x Breakthrough Officer Pack and 2 Standard Packs.
[*]And finally, the 10 players drawn from the pool of participants will receive 1x Breakthrough Officer Pack and 1 Standard Pack.[/list]

So get those draft tier lists updated, and get building those decks! Draft weekend awaits!

notes.title: Breakthrough - The KARDS winter expansion is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/c14386b09899642c4cac763db35f55d7889466f2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Breakthrough - The KARDS winter expansion is live![/h2]

Breakthrough, our third massive expansion for KARDS, introduces a wealth of fundamentally new strategic possibilities and tactical options to KARDS, all inspired by real-world WW2 history. 

Explore never-seen-before research mechanics motivated by actual WW2 research projects to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

[previewyoutube=3QW8DbOweRM;full][/previewyoutube]

Additional new features, like the Pincer attack ability or the ability to steal enemy units, significantly expand the array of tactical options available and bring the game experience to a new level.

Breakthrough arrives with a total of 81 new cards, many of them with new effects introduced for the first time in this expansion, reinforcing players with thrilling new tools to challenge their opponents and dominate the battlefield with tactical skills and strategic thinking.

Breakthrough was published on December 9th and is an automatic update for all KARDS players.

[h1]A new era for KARDS[/h1]

With the arrival of Breakthrough on December 9, KARDS entered a completely new era.

These are the highlights of Breakthrough:
[list][b][*]81 new unique cards in total
[*]Research cards now available to unleash devastation
[*]Pincer as a new core ability
[*]New mechanics to control enemy units
[*]New mechanics to select cards in hand for special improvements
[*]Numerous bug fixes and smaller improvements
[/b][/list]

Further Breakthrough info:
[list][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2898591790312528761]Breakthrough card reveals - First info[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2898592423873547518]Breakthrough card reveals - Second strike[/url]
[*][url=https://www.kards.com/en/decks/collection?set=Breakthrough]Breakthrough cards: Full collection[/url]
[/list]

To further spotlight these massive changes, together with the best KARDS players we have prepared a special Breakthrough walkthrough video for you:

[previewyoutube=99oca41QM24;full]Breakthrough walkthrough video[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Research enters KARDS[/h2]

Breakthrough introduces Research as a new feature and gameplay option.

Inspired by historical projects of strategic impact, you can now use Research to either support your current strategy or to create a strong complement, depending on which route you take.

Each Research phase leaves you with the choice: reap the benefit you have gained so far, or further invest in the hope of reaching a true research breakthrough later on and before it is too late.

Will you stay the course for the ultimate rewards like the Manhattan Project or try to capitalize on early returns? Can you survive long enough?

[h2]New Pincer ability[/h2]

In military terms, a pincer movement is a coordinated and simultaneous attack of separate forces to encircle the enemy and then simultaneously attack them on both flanks or from opposing directions. The maneuver relies on both groups encircling the enemy to succeed in deploying their devastating blow. The pincer movement was an integral part of the German Blitzkrieg and was often used to shocking effect during World War II.

The KARDS Pincer ability is inspired by this real-world tactic and recreates this attack in an abstract yet realistic way on the battlefield.

When a Pincer unit enters the battlefield, you can choose another friendly unit as a counterpart of the Pincer. This effect is the abstraction of two units working together to pincer the opponent. Only while both units are on the battlefield will they both get the Pincer benefit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/f1037760fdd2d86da2845ca2648f7dd73d37adfe.png[/img]

For example: A Pincer: +2 Attack would give the Pincer unit +2 attack and the other selected unit +2 attack - as long as they both are on the battlefield. If either unit is removed from the battlefield, the other remaining unit automatically loses the +2 Pincer attack bonus.

[h2]Control enemy units[/h2]

On the battlefield, chaos can reign, and friendly fire can become as deadly as enemy attacks. Switching sides during WWII was also not uncommon, even for nations. At the start of WWII Romania, Bulgaria and Italy were allied with the Axis powers, but the war’s developments in later years would influence these countries decisions to switch their allegiance to the Allies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/7a4709a68c7c2be64a76c2815614d6beb8550263.png[/img]

An example of take control is CONFUSION, where you can take control of an enemy unit, with cost of 3 or less, until end of turn. This effect is the abstraction of a unit becoming confused during battle and therefore not acting as they should.

Another example is MINORITY RECRUITS, where you can take full control of an enemy unit. This effect is the abstraction of turning to the enemy.

[h1]Welcome to Breakthrough![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/544810/KARDS__The_WWII_Card_Game/

notes.title: Introducing Officer Packs
notes.content:
[h3]We are excited to expand KARDS with a new, additional type of card pack starting this Friday, November 13th: [b]Officer Packs![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/c64846acdcf1e4071896cb7c1418b9453d7e3fd2.jpg[/img]

The new Officer Packs will contain more cards, a much higher drop rate of rare cards in each pack as well as a guarantee to get rarer cards. 

Based on your feedback and our own research, these packs are designed to help you build your collection of Special and Elite cards faster even after you have collected most of the base cards of each set - something that previously could be quite time consuming. We believe that these new packs, in addition to the already existing pack types, will give you a much better experience and allow you to choose the best way to build up your collection.

Officer Packs will be available in the KARDS in-game store for real money and in-game gold (more about that down below). The current Packs will, of course, continue to be available in the store as they always have been.

[h2]Officer Packs: Bigger, better, more oomph![/h2]
The Officer Packs are designed to expand on your collection and are likelier to contain rarer cards for your collection. The contents of each Officer Pack:
[list]
[*] 7 Cards from a set
[*] Of these 7 cards, 1 Special Card or better from that set
[*] Of these 7 cards, 2 Limited Cards or better from that set
[/list]
As you can see, there are more cards in the new Officer Packs, 7 instead of the 5. In addition, from the cards you draw, you will receive at least one guaranteed special card (or better) plus 2 limited cards (or better).

In addition to the guarantees mentioned, the drop rate for rarer cards has also doubled, creating a higher chance  for more than 3 cards of limited rarity or better to appear in a single pack.

[h2]Card draw chances: The details[/h2]
We want to give you the best overview and information about the new Officer Packs so that you can make the best choice to either build up your collection with the current Standard Packs or to expand it with the new Officer Packs. The choice is yours!
Therefore we offer full transparency of the chances to draw rare cards.
First of all, remember that the Officer Packs include two guarantees:
[olist][*] Each Officer pack contains at least 1 card that is of special rarity or better.
[*] Each Officer pack contains at least 2 cards of limited rarity or better.
[/olist]
The base distribution for the packs can be seen below, where each card has a 60% chance of being a standard card, 29% of being a limited card, 8% of being a special card and 3% of being an elite card.

If you have not drawn a limited (or rarer) card after the first four cards, one of the guarantees comes into play: The remaining 3 cards in the pack are then at least of limited rarity. The chance to get a limited card is 89%, a special card 8% and an elite card 3%.

If after 6 cards you have not drawn any special (or rarer) cards, the other guarantee is activated: The last card is then guaranteed to be a special card (70% chance) or an elite card (30% chance).

[h2]Bigger or cheaper: The choice is yours![/h2]
Officer Packs are bigger and contain better cards than the current Packs. This considerable advantage is reflected by a higher price tag on the Officer Packs.

The new packs will be available for $4.45 or 30 Gold each. Bundles and special offers will be available too where you can save quite a bit.

We believe that this gives you a fair option to choose between building up your collection with Standard Packs in the beginning, and then, when you have a sizable enough collection, continuing at a slightly slower rate but with more impact by switching over to Officer Packs.

The new packs will be available for all card sets and arrive on 13th of November.

notes.title: Reconnect - Field testing ahead
notes.content:
Great news for all KARDS players, newcomers and veterans alike! KARDS is currently receiving a technical boost with the first public test of the reconnect feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/2b2c97ae3f3fbfcafd62e06d9f313526eb7e0e2b.jpg[/img]

We gladly announce the first field test of this reconnect feature between 4th and 6th of November.
No further action is required on your end to participate; the test will be conducted automatically.

[h2]Background info[/h2]
The KARDS reconnect feature introduces an automatic, fast, and reliable reconnection to a currently active match if its connection was lost due to brief network or traffic issues. This will happen automatically and shouldn't cause any disruption of the game.

Before reconnect, a lost connection usually resulted in a match loss.

[h2]Next steps[/h2]
Reconnect is a complex technical feature. Therefore, we conduct this field test to gather telemetry under live conditions and test the reconnection feature.

For testing purposes we might be turning the feature on and off during the next few days while we gather some telemetry on how it is doing. Don't be alarmed if it is on and off in the coming few days.

After this field test, we will analyze the results. Once we are satisfied and all quality requirements are checked, we will go live with this feature!

You are, of course, most welcome to use the comments below for feedback or report any issues on [url=http://discord.gg/kards]KARDS Discord[/url].

notes.title: Halloween in KARDS
notes.content:
Honor the historical wartime efforts at the homefront during Halloween and play KARDS on a uniquely decorated Halloween battlefield! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/9bf298ca27b0a7aac5e2da64b9c995a10a6db9c2.jpg[/img]

Simply log in and enjoy this unique feature from October 29th to November 1st.

[h2]Easy Company bundle[/h2]
During the Halloween period, you can also strengthen your forces and benefit from our USA Easy Company special!

This unique bundle gives you 5 card packs, an additional guaranteed USA Elite card, and, as a bonus, the revered Easy Company card back.

[b]This bundle is only available during the Halloween period.[/b]

[h2]Historical background[/h2]
Traditionally, Halloween is a night of great mischief from young and old alike.

Wartime Halloween, however, was very different. During the critical period, when all efforts were towards outproducing the enemy and surviving the harsh realities of war with food shortages and rationing of essential goods, Halloween's focus changed.

Some people called the Halloween mischief to be sabotage and treason, helping the axis powers. Treat-or-trick activities were considerably reduced. Evening ringing doorbells to collect candy was not welcome: Government reasoning for this drastic change was that tired factory workers needed all the rest they could get; war efforts should not be disturbed by pranks.

Instead, there was a surge in organized activities, and the movies ran double shifts. Costumes and parades were wildly popular.

[h2]KARDS during Halloween[/h2]
To honor these efforts at the homefront, enjoy playing KARDS on our Halloween battlefield and take advantage of the Easy Company bundle.

As Halloween marks the end of the month, you can additionally benefit from climbing the ranks and reaping the benefits with your seasonal rewards shortly after.

[b]Don’t miss out on this extravaganza from October 29th to November 1st![/b]

[*] 14th of November - 4 rounds of Bo3
[*] 15th of November - 3 rounds of Bo3

notes.title: KARDS Living Roadmap 🌟 Update
notes.content:
Dear KARDS players, friends, and WWII enthusiasts,

It is with great pleasure and excitement that we present the freshly updated KARDS roadmap. The roadmap is a regularly updated, high-level overview of the milestones and important events for KARDS. Keep in mind that this is a living document and that the events further in the future will receive more info as time passes by. 

Without further ado, let’s have a look at what we can expect in the coming months! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/ce56fe8a98799a16b746896e3e852432d3258e6e.png[/img]

Let’s go briefly over each item; more details will follow with separate blogs closer to the actual release dates. 

[h2]October[/h2]
[h3]Two new languages: Italian and Spanish[/h3] 
Great news from the multilingual KARDS front: Starting on October 1st, KARDS is available in two additional, often-requested languages [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2872691653191478436]Spanish and Italian[/url].

[h3]Reconnect[/h3] The long-awaited reconnect feature! In case of losing connection to the KARDS server, you will now automatically reconnect (if possible); then you can continue the ongoing match.

[h2]November[/h2]
[h3]National Progression[/h3] A complete overhaul of the national progression and their long-term achievements. This allows you to better and faster reap the benefits from playing your favorite nations.

[h3]Mac client Release[/h3] Often requested and anticipated by many. The Mac version of KARDS will arrive in November! 


[h2]December[/h2]
[h3]Winter expansion[/h3] This expansion is one of the two highlights this winter. Similar to our [url=https://www.kards.com/kards-allegiance]Allegiance expansion[/url] previous winter, expect to see new cards and game mechanics! 

[h3]World Championship Qualifier and Finals[/h3] The second highlight this winter next to the expansion is the KARDS World Championship! Similar to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/544810/announcements/detail/1725372378542312727]previous World Championship[/url], we will have qualifiers and then the actual tournament with a grand final. The qualification period has already started, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2785996724660102721]check out the details[/url]!  

[h2]2021[/h2]
[h3]Mobile version[/h3]
Highly anticipated, the mobile version for Android and iOS devices allows you to connect and play anywhere you want. Of course, you keep all your cards and your collection when using the mobile client - you have the full multi-platform experience! Initially scheduled for Q2 2020, we have moved the release of the mobile version to early 2021 as we want to have more time to develop and deliver a true triple-AAA experience on your mobile device. We don’t want to compromise quality for a rushed delivery that doesn’t pay justice to your (and our) expectations. We are still committed and very excited about the mobile version! 


The roadmap is painted in broad strokes and shows only the tip of what we have planned. There are many more small features and improvements which will come along the road.

As you can see, the final Quarter of 2020 is packed with KARDS excitement and good things to come!


The whole team is thrilled for the future and would love to hear your feedback! Join our [url=http://discord.gg/kards]KARDS Discord[/url] or use the comments below.

notes.title: Battle of Moscow 🎖️ Invitational tournament
notes.content:
Hello KARDS players!

It's time for another commemorative event, this time remembering the Battle of Moscow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/dcad2ae438132ca6683a29b2da052263c7cc3d08.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Historical background[/h2][/u]
Operation Barbarossa, the German invasion plan for the Soviet Union, called for Moscow's capture within four months. Having gained significant ground since their invasion on the 22nd of June in 1941, the Germans found themselves close to accomplishing their goal of capturing Moscow when they secured Smolensk, an important stronghold on the way to Moscow. The Germans, however, could not advance further due to the risk of exposing their flanks, so they turned their attention to Leningrad and Kiev. When the advance on Moscow resumed on the 30th of September 1941, the German forces were weakened, and the Soviets had reinforced the city. This was the beginning of the end for the hopes of a German victory in the USSR.

[u][h2]New tournament format: King of the Hill[/h2][/u]
To commemorate the Battle of Moscow's incredible events, we will be hosting an invitational tournament with a brand new format: King of the Hill!

In this tournament, 8 invited players will compete against each other to find out who is the true king of the Soviets in Kards.

Each player can bring two different Mono-Soviet decks (only including Soviet cards) and an unlimited amount of additional decks, provided they only contain cards from a single nation that isn't the Soviet Union.

At the beginning of the tournament, players draw a number from 1-8. 

Player number 1 starts the tournament as the king of the hill, having to defend it using one of their two Soviet decks against the challengers, players 2-8, that can field any non-Soviet deck in a bid to defeat the king and claim the hill as their own.

At the end of play, the player with the most successful defenses of the hill will be crowned winner and undisputed Soviet champion.

[u][h2]Eight champions[/h2][/u]
The players competing in the Battle of Moscow Invitational are:
[list][*] Innocent Bubbles
[*] Spooz
[*] Darkness
[*] Jking7
[*] ToDieIsGain
[*] Doge34
[*] Blue_Blast
[*] AriBigBehn
[/list]

[u][h2]Live on Twitch[/h2][/u]
Join us for all the action and check out the craziest decks the best minds in KARDS can bring!

The fun and action starts at 16:00 UTC on the 4th of October, live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kardsccg]our Twitch channel[/url] - www.twitch.tv/kardsccg.

See you there!

notes.title: KARDS World Championship 2020 🏆 Get ready!
notes.content:
Hello Kards community!

As we near the end of the first qualification stage for the 2020 KARDS World Championship, it's time to give an update on the upcoming stages all the way to the finals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/9f810646cada6148c328947dab1b355d1f3488e1.jpg[/img]

The KARDS World Championship is a 128-player tournament with the final four players fighting for a $10.000 prize pool at the end of this year.

This year we are hosting the World Championship in the middle of crunch time. We work on a whole host of new and exciting features, including reconnect, a brand new onboarding experience, reworking and fine-tuning the in-game progression systems and working on the overall quality of life. This means we will also utilize external tools to reduce the need for specialized, one-time solutions and avoid overloading the programming department. 

Therefore we will be hosting Stage 2 in the client and Stage 3 on the popular Battelfy tournament platform. Here are all the details for each stage:

[u][h2]Stage 1 [/h2][/u]
Stage 1 has been ongoing for the last six seasons; the top 10 players of the ladder each season have qualified for the tournament. The last chance to be eligible via Stage 1 ends on September 30th with the current season's end.

[u][h2]Stage 2[/h2][/u]
In stage 2, we need to find 64 players to round out the top 128 (60 players from Stage 1 plus for the previous World Championship finalist are already set). 
To get the best 64 players possible to round out the top 128 for this year's World Championship, we will be awarding qualification spots to the top 64 players on the ladder that have not qualified for the tournament so far.

The top 64 players of the ladder at the end of Season 19 that are not qualified already qualify for the World Championship tournament. Season 19 starts October 1st and ends October 31st at 11:59 pm (UTC). 

We hope to ensure a high level of play in the World Championship and provide additional incentives for people to play the ladder during the season outside of the top 12 in the Officer Club that qualifies for the monthly Officer Club Championship tournament.

[u][h2]Stage 3[/h2][/u]
In stage 3, we need to go from 128 of our finalists down to the top 4.

Last year this was done through a massive single elimination bracket in the client, and while we could do that again, we have listened to the player feedback. Instead, we will be running two Swiss tournaments to find the top 16 players before moving over to a single-elimination bracket to get our final 4.

This means that we will host a 128 person swiss tournament that promotes 8 players into the finals, and then a 120 person swiss tournament promotes the remaining 8 players for our top 16.

We will then play a single-elimination tournament with those 16 players to determine the top 4, which then fight for their share of the $10.000 prize pool alive.

Our goal with this format is to reduce the tournament's variance as much as we can by giving players as many matches as possible to earn their spot, limiting the impact of bad draws in single matches.

The dates for stage 3 matches are as follows:

7. November - Swiss round 1
8. November - Swiss round 1
14. November - Swiss round 2
15. November - Swiss round 2
21. November - Top 16
22. November - Top 16

[u][h2]Finals[/h2][/u]
Unfortunately, due to the ongoing global pandemic of Covid-19, we will not be flying players to compete in a studio in Iceland for this year's World Championship. This has been a hard decision for us to make, but given the circumstances, an inevitable one. Instead, the tournament will be played entirely online. Despite all of this, we can not wait to bring you a fantastic show for the World Championship finals on the 5th and 6th of December!

Join our [b][url=http://discord.gg/kards]KARDS Discord[/url][/b] server, follow us on  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kardsccg]Twitch[/url], and subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVp6iL4xiS8ra1JvNfEd7aA]YouTube channel[/url], so you don't miss a second of the action!

notes.title: New login rewards for KARDS
notes.content:
Exciting news for you! A new daily reward track is available from September 15th onwards for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/48cb47fc6d55411a19943130dbd26d6f34d1d3fd.png[/img]

[h2]How it works[/h2]
You will receive a reward on first log in and then for the next seven days you log in. The prizes you receive are carefully selected to support you on your journey to build and improve your deck, starting with a base pack and then building up to an elite card on the final day of the track.

[h2]Background [/h2]
This new feature is part of a larger effort to improve KARDS based on your excellent feedback and our own research. One of the big themes we noticed was that new players feel KARDS is too slow initially and takes too long to build a good deck. Investigating this further, we found that despite the many cards new players receive during their first steps, these cards don't show the true potential of KARDS; they also don't open the path to exciting playstyles fast enough. Therefore we are adding an additional track of daily rewards to the new player experience. 

[h2]No one is left behind [/h2]
[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34861374/024e343d74970efa9083155b7007c5440c38569e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/504ee63bb32bad02e8fe9a86bc26c00423dd5af1.jpg[/img][/url]
We believe that these rewards are especially helpful for new players to quickly build up a good collection and explore the many exciting aspects of KARDS. However, our esteemed veteran players can enjoy this feature, of course, as no one is left behind! 

[h2]More to come[/h2]
The recent patch on September 1st with its change to the Theaters of War cards (you can create them with resources now) and this new feature of a daily reward are just the start. There is more to come for new and veteran players alike, the pipeline for the next weeks and months is nicely filled. Stay tuned for updates!
 
Until then, enjoy playing KARDS, claim your daily rewards, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Battle of Britain - Invitational Tournament
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/06b541bd76a30b8b60e812d6e7a8ca36ffad436a.jpg[/img]

Hello Kards community!

The fierce conflict in the skies over Britain between the British RAF and Fleet Air Arm of the Royal Navy against the German Luftwaffe has since been named the Battle of Britain. This conflict is commemorated on September 15th each year in the United Kingdom on what has become called the Battle of Britain Day.

In KARDS, we will also commemorate this event with a brand new card back, a limited time offer, and a very special tournament, featuring the best players in the game. 

[h2]Battle of Britain Invitational[/h2]

To pay tribute to the conflict that happened in the Battle of Britain, we invite some of the best KARDS players in the world to join us for a great tournament!

Each player will bring two decks to the tournament, one composed entirely of British cards, and the other entirely of German cards. They will then take turns playing their German deck against the opponent's British deck and, if needed, pick either deck for the deciding third match! 

We are eagerly looking forward to seeing the creativity in deck building from these players and for all the new and crazy stuff we are sure to see them bring to the table.

All the action will be streamed on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kardsccg]Twitch page www.twitch.tv/kardsccg[/url] on the [b]15th of September at 15:00 UTC[/b]. Join, and follow the action between our best players!


[h2]Stream giveaways[/h2]
As an added bonus to all the festivities, we will be running a [b]giveaway of 3 packs every few minutes[/b] in Twitch chat for the broadcast's full duration on September 15th. The only thing you have to do to be eligible for the giveaway is watching the broadcast while logged in to Twitch and type something in the chat and cheer for your favorites so we know you are there!

[h2]New RAF Cardback[/h2]
To commemorate the victory the RAF won over the German Luftwaffe in The Battle of Britain, we will release a brand new RAF inspired card back. 


There is more to come, keep an eye on the news!

notes.title: KARDS Update - September 1st (1.0.2902)
notes.content:
This update, the first one after the summer break, delivers a large amount of changes and updates that are improving KARDS. The update was published on September 1st.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/b71bc82645abceb610d6cde5e4b098f39725fc2e.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
These are the highlights of the update, details are further down in the actual patch notes:
[list][*]Many [b]card balance changes and updates[/b]. Watch the [url=https://youtu.be/nGwC-Gw0xvs]in-depth video about these great card changes[/url]!
[*]All [b]Theaters of War cards can be created now[/b] using in-game resources. 
[*][b]Changes to PIN mechanic[/b]. Pinned units stay pinned until the end of their owners next turn.
[*][b]Simultaneous effects[/b] (e.g. To the Last Man + Akita Regiment) utilize a new system resulting in better consistency and predictability.
[*][b]Buffs and debuffs[/b] that temporarily reduce values below zero can still take full effect now.
[*]Over 100 individual [b]bug fixes[/b].
[/list]
 
As always, your feedback is most welcome! Please use our [url=http://discord.gg/kards]KARDS Discord [/url] or the comments below.
 
[h1]Balance updates[/h1]
17 cards have been updated with new balance changes. Learn more about these updates and join the [url=https://youtu.be/nGwC-Gw0xvs]in-depth review with Blue Blast and Olikrummi[/url]. 

[h3]Japan[/h3]
[list][*]D4Y SUISEI: Destruction effect changed to “Pin all enemy ground units.” (was: “Pin all enemy units.”).
[*]G4M1 BETTY: Card effect changed to “If discarded, enter the support line instead. Deployment: Discard a random card from your hand” (was: “Deployment: Discard a random card from your hand.”).
[*]HONORABLE DEATH: Changed to “Destroy target unit with attack 3 or less. Owner of the unit draws a card” (was: “Destroy target unit with attack 2 or less. Owner of the unit draws a card.”).
 [/list]

[h3]Germany[/h3]
[list][*]BREAKTHROUGH: Changed to “Remove Guard, Ambush, and Smokescreen from all enemy units. Draw a card.” (was: “Changed to “Remove Guard, Ambush, and Smokescreen from all enemy units.”).
[*]FAST HEINZ: Changed to “Give your German tanks in the frontline +2+1.” (was: “Give your German tanks +2+1.”).
[*]JOINT OPERATION: Changed to “Deal damage to target unit equal to 1 plus the number of unit types you control.” (was “Deal damage to enemy target equal 1 plus the number of unit types you control.”)
[*]PANZER III-H: Defense changed from 5 to 4.
[*]Sd KFz 222: Defense changed from 2 to 1.
[/list]

[h3]Great Britain[/h3]
[list][*]BLACK WATCH: Deployment cost increased from 4 to 5. Defense increased from 4 to 6. 
[*]HUDSON Mk III: Card effect changed to “When Hudson destroys a unit, it gets Fury until the end of the turn.” (was: “Units damaged by Hudson are pinned.”).
 [/list]

[h3]USA[/h3]
[list][*]109 COMBAT ENGINEERS: Defense increased from 1 to 2. Card effect changed to “When another friendly unit moves into the frontline, give it +1 attack” (was: “When another friendly unit moves into the frontline, give it +1+1.”)
[*]CARRIER COVER: Cost reduced from 4 to 3.
[*]STRAFING: Cost reduced from 2 to 1.
[*]THE ALLIANCE: Cost increased from 4 to 5.
[/list]

[h3]Soviet Union[/h3]
[list][*]2nd MOTOR RIFLES: Deployment cost reduced from 4 to 3.
[*]FRONTAL ASSAULT: Changed to “Give your Light Infantry units +1+2. If you have none, add two to your hand.” (was: “Give your Light Infantry units +1+1. If you have none, add two to your hand.”).
[*]NIGHT WITCHES: Changed to “Add a POLIKARPOV PO-2 and FROM THE PEOPLE to hand. Shuffle NIGHT WITCHES into your deck.” (was “Add a POLIKARPOV PO-2 to support line. Shuffle NIGHT WITCHES into your deck.”).
[/list]
 
[h1]Game mechanics[/h1]
We have reworked several game mechanics to make them more intuitive and consistent. Please carefully review those changes.
  
[h2]Changes to PIN mechanic[/h2]
[b]Unit that is pinned can't move or attack. Pin is removed at the end of the owner's next turn.[/b]

This new version is much easier to understand and more intuitive. Instead of denying the next possible action and then removing the pin, now the pin lasts until the end of the owner’s next turn.
 
[h2]Buff and Debuff changes[/h2]
[b]Temporary and conditional changes that are made to the kredit cost, operation cost and attack value of cards will now be separated from the actual values.[/b] The way buff and debuffs are working has been changed. 
 
The attack buff value of a card can be both positive and negative numbers while the actual attack value cannot go below zero, and if the sum of the actual attack and attack buff value is a negative number then the total attack will work as a zero.
 
[u]Example 1[/u] 
Before these changes, cards like 85 PIONEER COMPANY did not affect orders that already had 0 kredit cost, but now will (e.g. if an enemy BLACK WATCH changes the kredit cost of your orders, then the order that had a cost of 0 before BLACK WATCH was played will cost 1 after it is played since the 85 PIONEER COMPANY is reducing it by 1). 
 
[u]Example 2[/u]
If a NAVAL SUPPORT is used on a unit with 5 defense but is already affected by a DIVE BOMBING, then the unit would have a total of 3 attack until the DIVE BOMBING effect wears off, instead of getting 5 attack and then going up to 7 when the DIVE BOMBING effect wears off.
 
[u]Example 3[/u]
If a ground unit with 5 attack is adjacent to a 10th ENGINEERS BATTALION is affected by a NAVAL SUPPORT, then the unit will get a total of 7 attack and end up with 5 when the buff from 10th ENGINEERS BATTALION is removed, instead of getting 5 attack after being affected by the NAVAL SUPPORT and ending up with 3 after losing the buff from the ENGINEERS.
 
[h2]Changes to simultaneous effects[/h2]
[b]Damage and destruction effects will happen simultaneously now.[/b]
 
Before this, cards that were destroying multiple cards (e..g TO THE LAST MAN that destroys all units on board) were actually putting all units on board in a queue and destroying each unit one by one and resolving the actions generated like destruction effect mid que. In some cases results of destroying multiple units at a time were unpredictable and could be frustrating at times.
For example if both players had units on board and one of the units was an AKITA REGIMENT and TO THE LAST MAN was played, the AKITA could deal its destruction effect damage to a unit that was already on board if the AKITA was before in the queue. The same goes if SIGNAL REGIMENT was being destroyed with friendly units, for example from TO THE LAST MAN, then the SIGNAL REGIMENT’s effect would only trigger for the cards that got killed before itself in the queue. 
 
With these changes now, SIGNAL REGIMENT will trigger for all friendly units being destroyed with it simultaneously and AKITAs destruction effect will only affect cards that weren’t being destroyed with it simultaneously.
 
[h1]General changes[/h1]
[list][*]All Theater of War cards can now be created with in-game resources.
[*]The Friend list has been updated to contain a new maximum of 100 friends.
[*]The AI can select now from twice as many decks as before and a wider range of cards. 
[/list]
 
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
Over 100 individual bugs have been fixed with this update! 
[h2]AI[/h2]
[list][*]Sometimes against the AI the first first drawn order is reduced twice when 85 PIONEER COMPANY is on the game board. Fixed.
[*]Players could end up with 10 cards in hand when AI used order on T-34 85. Fixed.
[*]ULTRA, secret operatives and interception weren't stopping orders correctly on AI’s turn. Fixed.
[*]AI got confused when ROOT OUT THE ENEMY affected 0 attack value units. Fixed.
[*]In AI matches the enemy does not always lose remaining Kredits after STRANGLEHOLD is triggered. Fixed.
[*]CARELESS TALK has -1 Kredit cost after drawing from deck when enemy A6M3 ZEKE is destroyed with similar countermeasure. Fixed.
[*]In AI matches friendly air unit operation cost increased by enemy EMBARGO is not reduced at the end of turn if P-61 BLACK WIDOW attacks during that turn. Fixed.
[*]F4F-4 WILDCAT wasn’t giving HQ smokescreen when spawned on AI's turn (for example by ISOLATION)
[*]In AI matches the STRATEGIC BOMBING animation is shown in the wrong direction if played after SEABORNE INVASION. Fixed.
[*]In AI matches the 10th GUARD REGIMENT gets an attack buff when DIVE BOMBING is used. Fixed.
[*]RESERVES wasn’t giving a correct amount of LIGHT INFANTRIES when played by the AI. Fixed.
[*]SHIBATA REGIMENT was taking damage while in AI’s hand. Fixed.
[*]756th REGIMENT and SHTURMOVIK were sometimes dealing it's excess damage incorrectly by the AI when an enemy ROYAL ULSTER RIFLES was on board. Fixed.
[*]Players 15th MOTOR RIFLES wasn’t giving HQ immune correctly on AI’s turn. Fixed.
[/list] 

[h2]Cards & Units[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed bug in 10th ENGINEERS buff when enemy used MOBILE DEFENSE.
[*]1st SIGNAL REGIMENT does not deal damage to the enemy HQ after destroying all your units, including itself, if it is placed earlier than other units. Fixed. See the above explanation about changes to simultaneous effects.
[*]The 321st RIFLES sometimes spaws the second LIGHT INFANTRY from the card update for the opponent. Fixed.

[*]In rare cases, the 85 PIONEER COMPANY was lowering the cost of an order by 2 instead of 1. Fixed.

[*]The ARGYLLSHIRE HIGHLANDERS bonus was sometimes not working with retreat. Fixed.

[*]Units affected by DIVE BOMBING after returning to hand with AA BARRAGE or NAVAL [*]BOMBARDMENT and then played again were [i]as funky as music can get[/i]. Fixed.
[*]Using ENCIRCLEMENT on KAGOSHIMA REGIMENT and then playing GUNSHIP MISSION or WE CAN DO IT does not stop the live gain. Fixed.

[h2]Game flow & Visuals[/h2]

notes.title: From 8 to 12 : New Officer Club Championship format
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/e904931e01961db73ce686f2f05633434842fec2.jpg[/img]

Hello Kards community!

As we draw closer to the end of the month we are also heading towards another Officer Club Championship. This time around we are shaking things up and introducing the next evolution of the Officer Club Championship (OCC).

[h2]From Top 8 to Top 12[/h2]

To give more players an opportunity to prove their worth at the top of the ladder, we will be expanding the qualified players from 8 to 12! With an increase in participants we are also making a slight format change to facilitate the extra competitors.

This time around, the top 4 players are guaranteed a spot in the quarterfinals, while the remaining 8 players in ranks 5-12 will battle each other for the remaining 4 spots in the quarter finals in a series of Best out of 3 matchups.

The broadcast stays the same.. For now..

On the broadcast side, everyone will still be able to tune in to the [url=https://twitter.com/KARDSccg]OCC broadcast[/url] and catch all the action from the top 8 while we look for opportunities to expand the broadcast part of the OCC to show more matches in the future.

Why make the change?

Since we introduced the OCC three months ago, we have seen fierce competition at the top of the ladder and we frequently see amazing players falling outside of the top 8 group. These are players we know have what it takes to bring home the OCC. As competitive scene in KARDS grows and matures, we want to provide that opportunity to as many players as possible.

That’s it, let the battle for the top 12 commence!

The next OCC will take place on the [b]12th of September[/b] from 15:00 UTC and will be broadcast live on our Twitch channel www.twitch.tv/kardsccg

notes.content:

Hello Kards enthusiasts!

A few months ago, the K-league had its first, small-scale tournament and completed it with success. Our format of the group stage, followed by double-elimination, allowed us to see what we could improve upon. And having evaluated this, it’s time for this competition to grow bold.

Starting September, the K-league makes its grand re-entrance into the competitive scene!
A weekly competition that comes to a conclusion every 3 weeks. The K-League provides opportunities for players to grow their skill in the competitive scene regardless of their current skill by providing different levels of competition, so everyone is sure to find something that suits!

The new format splits the competition into 3 divisions. 
[list]
[*] Gold division
[*] Silver division
[*] Copper division
[/list]
 
Each division comes with its own prizes and difficulty. With gold having the best prizes and toughest opponents and copper being the entry-level division. Each season will see the top players promoted up a division, and the bottom players relegated down a division.

The tournament will be covered with regular live streams on the dedicated Twitch channel [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kardsleague]twitch.tv/Kardsleague[/url] so make sure to head on over and give it a follow.

notes.title: KARDS: Theaters of War
notes.content:
Large-scale reinforcements have arrived in KARDS with Theaters of War, adding massive single-player content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/7ef3c8b42a57e0db654792d047cfb67186ad9b77.jpg[/img]

The Theaters of War update brings five single-player campaigns to the game, each representing some of the most iconic battles of the era. The update includes 40 unique new cards that unlock as players complete the campaigns, delivering further depth and strategic gameplay. 

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
Here are the highlights of Theaters of War:
✮ Five complete single-player campaigns, one for each major nation
✮ Each campaign has five historically inspired scenarios
✮ Three different strategies to play through each campaign
✮ Five new Headquarters and boards that can be used in PVP as well
✮ 105 cards including 10 Elite cards

For feedback, please use the [url=https://forms.gle/eJ5AUo751oVfrwt46]Theaters of War feedback[/url] form. It takes less than 1 minute and helps a lot.

Let's dig into the details!

[h2]Single-player campaigns[/h2]
KARDS five main nations - Britain, Germany, Japan, USA, and the Soviet Union - each receive their own unique campaign inspired by some of the most iconic battles of the Second World War. You can use one of three strategies to complete each campaign (more about that below). 

[h3]The Tunisian Campaign[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/0a55ce2a271e46170ae0a758ee2168b24da4b97c.jpg[/img]
Following Operation Torch and the fall of Morocco and Algeria, the race was on for Tunisia. 

Take charge of the British forces on their march to Tunis City to capture the capital and facilitate the surrender of all Axis forces in the area. 

You have available the following strategies (more about strategies below). 
[list][*]Travel by the coast and getting naval support
[*]Gain support from the Vichy French for numerical superiority
[*]Outflank the Axis with your 'Blade Force' and American allies
[/list]

[h3]El Alamein[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/765c74a9ea0e7061582bb3e71bb0fd59cd7de18e.jpg[/img]
In this campaign, you take charge of the German Afrika Korps sent to Libya to stem the advance of the British. Take the fight to Egypt, securing Alexandria and the Suez Canal itself.

You have available the following strategies (more about strategies below). 
[list][*]Rely on Rommel's tactical prowess to get the most out of the troops
[*]Secure the supply route and dominate in the long haul
[*]Call in the Italian forces close in hand for support
[/list]

[h3]Fall of the Philippines[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/c1b3238f96a17ec665267c84f4409bf175308f44.jpg[/img]
Imperial Japan is on the offensive as they invade the Philippines hours after the attack on Pearl Harbor. 

Successfully taking control of the Philippines secures a supply line from the Japanese home islands, provides a stepping stone for further conquests and deprives the US of an advance base in the region.

You have available the following strategies (more about strategies below). 
[list][*]Focus on your jungle warfare experience
[*]Rely on your air superiority
[*]Go for the brute-force approach with battle-hardened units
[/list]

[h3]Guadalcanal[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/593e96482f134e4d784d53dba8f9daada147c428.jpg[/img]
The Guadalcanal campaign was the first major allied land offensive against the Empire of Japan. The island contains an airfield that can prove decisive in turning the allies from waging a defensive war into an offensive one.

You have available the following strategies (more about strategies below). 
[list][*]Strengthen and rely on the core of the US marine force
[*]Focus on securing the Henderson Field for air support
[*]Rely on the US navy for support and keeping the Japanese at bay
[/list]

[h3]Battle of Moscow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/19eaaff1832718a651f4e3b0da5303b374a8677b.jpg[/img]
Operation Barbarossa saw Germans advance far into the Soviet Union on all fronts. After Kiev, most of the trained Soviet reserves were depleted and the Germans are on Moscow's doorsteps. 

Take charge of the Soviet defensive to halt the German advance to Moscow and take advantage of the winter to turn the tides of the invasion. 

You have available the following strategies (more about strategies below). 
[list][*]Retreat your elite units from the Far Eastern front for support
[*]Rely on the people of Moscow to dig entrenchments and anti-tank ditches into slowing down your enemy
[*]Call in the reserves and get as many able bodies on the field
[/list]


[h2]Strategies and upgrades[/h2]
Each campaign offers three different strategies (see above) to achieve operational success. You will receive different units and orders throughout the campaign, which can vastly change the approach to victory.

Each different strategy requires an entirely different approach and is inspired by historical events. 

As you progress through the campaign, you will upgrade your units to better tackle what is to come and provide multiple different paths to success. The combination of different strategies and units to enhance results in fun and engaging replay value for each of the campaigns.

[h2]105 new cards[/h2]
Theaters of War brings 40 new unique playable cards, 8 for each of the main nations for your collection. You earn the new cards as you complete each phase of the campaign. 

As you progress, you unlock the complete set for each card (all 4 standard cards, all 3 limited or both special cards), getting 21 cards per nation or 105 for all 5 nations.

Have a look at our pre-release review of all cards in Theaters of War. The analysis includes some of the top players in KARDS and gives great insight.
https://youtu.be/AZRZA1mLlDo

[h2]New Headquarters and boards[/h2]
Each campaign comes with a unique headquarter (HQ) that provides a new and unique board setting. 

These HQ’s can then be used in other game modes where you invite your opponent to your board setting. Each campaign also comes with a unique card back for the nation, further allowing you to personalize your presence in the game.

If you are one of the few elite players finishing a campaign completing all secondary objectives (stars), you will get a special emote. 

[h2]Purchase with gold or currency[/h2]
Theaters of War is available now in the KARDS shop (in-game). You can purchase the campaigns individually or as a bundle. 

You can purchase the campaigns either with currency or with in-game gold.

The individual campaigns cost either $7.95 or 100 Gold.
The bundle of all five campaigns costs $29.95 and saves you up to 25%.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
We are looking forward with great excitement to Theaters of War how you will successfully complete the various campaigns. 

Your feedback is precious, and we would love to hear your opinion.

Please use the comments below or join our [url=https://discord.gg/kards]KARDS Discord server[/url], thank you!

notes.title: Deck of the Week
notes.content:
Hello KARDS Community!

Welcome to the third edition of the Deck of the Week, a weekly article where we look at a player submitted deck and break it down into details. The point of the series is to bring to the surface all kinds of fun, effective and in-meta decks so players looking for direction can know what to strive for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/e84e50d9a491199a4edf747258129c2c944de181.jpg[/img]

As always, this wouldn’t be possible without the amazing support and passion from you guys in the community, and if you want to submit your own deck for the chance to be featured in the coming weeks, please fill out the following [url=https://forms.gle/j2SYB46a21oaTpGA6]Deck of the Week suggestion[/url] form.

Now, without further ado, let’s check out the Deck of the Week, this time submitted by the lord of combo decks, [b]Scout[/b]! 
We have a German and USA combo deck affectionately known in the community as [i]Baby Combo[/i] as it runs no units that cost more than 4K.

[h2]Deck of the Week[/h2]
[quote=Scout]
USA Baby Combo
Major power: Germany
Ally: USA
HQ: DANZIG

Germany:
4x (0K) RUSH PRODUCTION
3x (1K) Sd KFz 222
2x (1K) ARADO AR 196
1x (1K) ADLER COMMAND VEHICLE
1x (1K) 158. NACHSCHUB
4x (2K) SPOILS OF WAR
4x (2K) 3.7cm FLAK 37
2x (2K) WIRBELWIND
2x (2K) PANZER 35(t)
1x (2K) AFRIKA KORPS
4x (3K) PANZER 38(t)
1x (3K) 15 cm AUTOKANONE
2x (4K) ENIGMA
2x (4K) PANZER III-H

USA:
2x (1K) 109th COMBAT ENGINEERS
2x (2K) GUNSHIP MISSION
2x (2K) INDUSTRIAL MIGHT

IMPORT CODE:
%%15|3W3N3m3O;3Xcrbr4G4pbs2Z4s;4A;3a3c414q
[/quote]

According to Scout here are the most important things to know about the deck.

[h3]How would you classify this deck?[/h3]
Combo - One turn kill. The deck is all about getting the required cards in hand and then executing your combo to take the opponent from full health (20hp or higher) and all the way down to 0!

[h3]What are the key strengths of this deck?[/h3]
It is amazingly fun and if you draw the required cards to execute the combo, there are very few counters that can stop you from winning. Just make sure to be aware of possible countermeasures that can kill your 15cm Autokanone when you deploy it!

[h3]What are the main weaknesses of this deck?[/h3]
You have a single way to win, and that’s it. If you don’t draw the correct cards and the opponent is playing a fast deck, the game can very easily be over before you manage to put up any type of fight!

[h3]What are the key points to playing this deck?[/h3]
The key cards are the 15cm Autokanone and Rush production along with all the little “baby” units. You are always looking for these cards from the very beginning of the game. Once you have at least 2 rush productions and the 15cm Autokanone in hand you can execute the combo.

To execute the combo you play one rush production, followed by the 15 cm Autokanone and another rush production (or more if you have them). Then you play all your cheapest units so they trigger the damage effect on the 15cm Autokanone and then are destroyed due to the Rush Production so they don’t block your support line and prevent you from playing more units.

Another key card included in this version of the deck is Afrika Korps, a new Elite card coming with the upcoming [url=https://www.kards.com/en/theaters-of-war]Theatres of War expansion[/url] that gives you an extra option to pull the 15cm Autokanone or even have two!

[b]Important note! Make sure to execute the combo fast, as the animations can take almost your whole turn![/b]


[h3]How do you mulligan? [/h3]
This deck is all about finding the 15cm Autokanone and the rush productions so you are looking for those or good draw cards in the mulligan.

[h3]Additional comments[/h3]
There are multiple versions of the Baby Combo deck utilizing different small units to trigger the effect of the 15cm Autokanone, so it is possible to have a lot of fun playing around with building different versions of this combo deck. We encourage you to have some fun and see if you can come up with a better version.

Additionally, getting the combo off requires some practice. So get ready to fail a couple of times while learning the ropes of the deck. To help you, Scout has created a compilation video of himself executing the combo using the deck above:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fh4xZrvS3h4


What do you think about this deck? Let us know in the comments along with what you would change or what deck you are currently running! You can also take part in conversations around deck building and ask for assistance in our [url=http://discord.gg/kards]Community Discord[/url].

notes.title: D-Day event 2020 - Successfully completed!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2220784205320538389]KARDS D-Day commemoration event 2020[/url] is completed and resulted in a major success!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34861374/c4e0ee02c1ea7255cf19f483349f3daa15c2b5e4.jpg[/img]


[h3]Success in Wave 3  and Final Day[/h3]
The KARDS community has successfully completed all objectives of this event, including the third wave  and the final challenge on Sunday. What a fantastic success!  Well done! As a result of this community effort, everyone who was logged in at some point during this third wave and Sunday has received the [b]reward of 1 draft ticket + 2 gold[/b] and one [b]Seaborne Invasion[/b] elite card or its equivalent in resources (you need to recycle it to get the resources).

The rewards have been added to all eligible players on June 15th at 10:00 UTC. Eligible is everyone who was logged in to KARDS at any point between Thursday and Saturday (midnight to midnight UTC) for the Draft ticket and Sunday for Seaborne invasion. 

Now, that this event is over, please use our feedback form and [url=https://forms.gle/noEPHm7MPm9Q2Taz8]let us know what you think about this event[/url]. 

[h3]Background info[/h3]
D-Day was the most massive seaborne invasion in history and started with the Normandy landings on Tuesday, June 6th, 1944. D-Day began the liberation of France (and later western Europe) and laid the foundation for the Allied victory on the Western Front.

We commemorate this historical event in KARDS with our first series of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/544810/view/2220784205320538389]community-wide challenges[/url].

[h3]Contribution and progression[/h3]
During this period, the community received a new objective every day. The daily goal was the same for everyone, this was a community event after all, and tied into the actual events of D-Day.

The D-Day challenges went over ten days which were grouped into three waves and a final day:
[list][*] [strike]First wave: Friday - Sunday (June 5th - 7th)[/strike] - COMPLETED 🎖️
[*] [strike]Second wave: Monday - Wednesday (June 8th - 10th)[/strike] - COMPLETED 🎖️
[*] [strike]Third wave: Thursday - Saturday (June 11th - June 13th)[/strike] -  COMPLETED 🎖️
[*] [strike]Final day: Sunday (June 14th)[/strike] -  COMPLETED 🎖️
[/list]

[h3]Reward payouts[/h3]
These community challenges span ten days and introduced exciting fun while connecting you to the historical events of D-Day. 

While the focus of this event was on the historical connection and commemoration of D-Day, rewards were nonetheless good to have.

The community received rewards for completing the objectives of each wave. Since each wave lasts for three days, the community was able to complete up to three daily goals per wave. The rewards were paid out only if all three challenges per wave have been completed. 


Rewards will be automatically delivered to your account for the next (work) day.
[list][*] [strike]Reward payouts for the first wave: Monday, June 8th[/strike] - DELIVERED 🎖️
[*] [strike]Reward payouts for the second wave: Thursday, June 11th[/strike] - DELIVERED 🎖️
[*] [strike]Reward payouts for the third way and the final day: Monday, June 15th[/strike] - DELIVERED 🎖️
[/list]

[b]Important![/b] 👉 Only if you have been logged in to play KARDS during a wave will you receive the rewards from this wave. Same goes for the final day.

Use our feedback form and [url=https://forms.gle/noEPHm7MPm9Q2Taz8]let us know what you think about this event[/url]. 


We hope that you enjoyed this first community-wide D-Day challenge, we are looking forward to your feedback and the next events!
